adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the mapping of results changes `credentialId` from `isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later to `result.credentialId ?? undefined`). This means when `isCalendarType` is false (i.e., non-calendar/video integrations), `credentialId` is now always `undefined` even if `result.credentialId` exists, which is a behavioral regression introduced by the diff.
